headline: Supreme Court Denies Interim Bail To Sharjeel Imam And Umar Khalid
seoTitle: Supreme Court Denies Bail to Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid
metaDescription: The Supreme Court of India refused interim bail for Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid, requesting the Delhi Police to respond to their ongoing UAPA petitions.
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India rejected the requests for interim bail filed by activists Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid.
Judges directed the Delhi Police to file a response regarding the activists' petitions in their respective UAPA cases.
The matter has been referred to the Chief Justice of India for the formation of a three-judge bench to review the case.
aiContextParagraph: Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid are currently seeking bail in relation to charges filed under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, commonly referred to as UAPA. In their recent pleas before the Supreme Court, the petitioners argued that the prosecution has not yet examined protected witnesses. Furthermore, they contended that a specific one-year embargo previously established by the Supreme Court concerning trial proceedings is approaching its expiration date. In response to the filings, the top court denied the request for immediate interim relief. The justices have officially issued a formal notice to the Delhi Police, requiring a response to the arguments presented by the activists. The bench presiding over the session instructed that the case files be submitted to the Chief Justice of India, who will oversee the administrative process of constituting a three-judge panel for further deliberation on the matter.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to significant public interest in the legal proceedings, supported by strong search activity and coverage from three major independent news outlets.
